info.description:
Adapter that answers the Rotector custom API contract from the SCSN and RAB
services.

Configure the Rotector extension with these URLs, replacing the host:

* SCSN single lookup: `https://your-host/v1/scsn/v1/lookup/user/{userId}`
* SCSN batch lookup:  `https://your-host/v1/scsn/v1/lookup/users`
* RAB single lookup:  `https://your-host/v1/rab/v1/lookup/user/{userId}`
* RAB batch lookup:   `https://your-host/v1/rab/v1/lookup/users`

All endpoints require an API key, issued in `Keys/Consumers.json` and accepted via
`X-Auth-Token`, `Authorization: Bearer` or a bare `Authorization` value. Both URL
schemes must be served over HTTPS. Handled errors are returned with HTTP 200 and a
{"success": false, "error": "..."} body, as the extension treats any other status
code as a failure.

A consumer can discover what its own key allows at `GET /v1/whoami`, and read its own
usage at `GET /v1/usage`.
info.summary: SCSN and RAB user flag lookups for the Rotector extension.
info.title: RoProtect - Rotector custom API

get.description:
Everything recorded about a single key fingerprint: its label, when it was first and last seen, how many requests it made in the window, how many distinct services, endpoints and Roblox user IDs it reached, its latency spread, and its per-service and per-outcome breakdown. The fingerprint comes from `GET /v1/admin/usage` or `GET /v1/whoami`; the raw key is never accepted here.

Parameters: `window` is how many hours to cover, default 720 (30 days).

Requires an admin key, and answers 401 or 403 like the other admin endpoints, plus 404 for a fingerprint that has never been seen.

get.description:
Buckets recorded requests by hour or day and splits each bucket by outcome, so a spike, a quiet period or a run of upstream errors is visible as a shape rather than a single total.

Parameters: `bucket` is `hour` or `day` (default `hour`); `window` is how many hours to cover, 1 to 8760 (default 24); `service` and `fingerprint` narrow it to one service or one key. Empty buckets are returned with zero requests rather than omitted, so the series is gap-free.

Requires an admin key, and answers 401 or 403 like the other admin endpoints.

get.description:
Looks up RAB (moco-co) group-membership records for one Roblox user.

Any tracked group membership is reported as `flagType` 1 (Flagged), with the count and breakdown by group type in the reasons and badges. A known user with no memberships is returned as `flagType` 0 (Unflagged), as is a user RAB has no record of. The content category is inferred from the reported group types and omitted when nothing matches.

Looks up SCSN group-membership records for one Roblox user.

get.description:
Looks up The All Seeing Eye (TASE) records for one Roblox user.

TASE indexes Discord accounts rather than Roblox accounts, so the Roblox user ID is first resolved to their Discord IDs, and those IDs are then scanned. Resolution walks a chain of verification services - RoWifi, then RoVer, then Bloxlink - and the first one that returns a link wins. Only Discord accounts whose owner gave reverse-search consent to one of those services can be matched, so an empty result is normal.

A user is reported as unflagged only when every service in the chain confirmed there is no link. If any of them is unreachable the lookup fails closed rather than guessing, so an error here means unknown, not clean.

Any server TASE detected the account in is reported as `flagType` 1 (Flagged), with the server names, detection types and activity score in the reasons and badges. A user TASE knows nothing about is returned as `flagType` 0 (Unflagged), as is a user with no consented Discord link. The content category is inferred from the reported detection types and omitted when nothing matches.

schema.description: Single-user lookup: either a record or a handled error.
schema.title: SingleLookupResponse

200.description: Single-user lookup: either a record or a handled error.
